reason: The promo code and escrow are the right idea, but $525 is a big chunk of my monthly spend on one post, and the follower counts and results are just what the creators say. With Meta ads I can see cost per sale; here I'd be betting $500 on numbers nobody checked.
objection: Follower counts and past results aren't verified, so I can't tell if a creator actually has local followers who'll walk into my place or just likes from bots and out-of-towners.
would_change_my_mind: Verified audience data showing how many of a creator's followers are in my city, plus real promo-code redemption numbers from past deals with businesses like mine.
